title: A sign-up page
request:
Build a sign-up page for a workshop. GET /eval-site-02 serves an HTML page with a
form that posts to /eval-site-02/signup. POST /eval-site-02/signup takes a JSON
body {"name": string, "email": string}, stores the sign-up, and answers 201 with
{"count": <total sign-ups so far>}. A body missing either field answers 400.
GET /eval-site-02/signups answers JSON {"names": [...]} listing the names in the
order they signed up, and never includes e-mail addresses.
